name: 56347 · Long Prairie, MN
findings: ZIP 56347 (Long Prairie) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56347 (Long Prairie) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
